slot_scores.name: eight_hour_shift_start_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What are the allowed shift start times and durations for drivers (e.g., 8-hour shifts starting at 6:00, 10:00, etc.)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about both shift start times and durations, directly covering the 8-hour continuous shift rule.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 hidden slot was resolved in turn 1 before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent asked a focused set of clarifying questions and resolved the key P0 hidden slot about shift duration and start times before stopping. The interaction quality is strong, with no silent assumptions on the scored hidden slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
